name: Allen County Board of Commissioners
role: County legislative body — party to the Project BOSC County instruments
summary: The three-member elected board that approved the County's Project BOSC instruments, including the Community Reinvestment Area agreement and the Roadwork Development Agreement.

name: Ohio EPA, Division of Air Pollution Control
role: Permitting authority — issued the project's air permit-to-install
summary: The state division that issued the air permit-to-install for the project (eDoc 4132514, 2026-05-28); the authority of record for air-permit comment and objection.

name: Allen Soil & Water Conservation District
role: Local district in the stormwater / wetland record
summary: The conservation district named across the site's stormwater, wetland-determination, and farm-tile-drainage record, and a respondent on the BOSC public-records production.
